macros.name: copySolnsOn
macros.doc: \copySolnsOn is the default, it causes the solutions to be copied at the end of the document; \copySolnsOff turns off the copying.

macros.name: declQSLOut
macros.doc: The destination filenames are \jobname-cpy.sol and \jobname-cpy.qsl by default, but these names can be changed through the commands \declSOLOut and \declQSLOut.

macros.name: declSOLOut
macros.doc: The destination filenames are \jobname-cpy.sol and \jobname-cpy.qsl by default, but these names can be changed through the commands \declSOLOut and \declQSLOut.

macros.name: ignoreques
macros.doc: If we don’t want to include the question, pass a special command \ignoreques in the optional ⟨inserts⟩ argument.

macros.name: insExSoln
macros.doc: If you marked a solution to an exercise, then use \insExSoln to insert that solution.

macros.name: insExSoln
macros.doc: If you marked a solution to an exercise, then use \insExSoln to insert that solution.

macros.name: readSolnsOff
macros.doc: If you expand \readSolnsOff, the commands \insExSoln, \insSqSoln, and \insQzSoln do not input their target file; instead \miReadOffMsg is typeset.
